entities.name: Church of Serra
entities.description: A religion on Dominaria dedicated to the goddess Serra, manifested through Serra Angels.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Goddess worshipped by the Church, actually a planeswalker.

entities.name: Serra Angels
entities.description: Main manifestation of the Church of Serra.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: Current leader of the Church of Serra and the Order of Dawn.

entities.name: Brother Angus
entities.description: Built the Cathedral of Serra around Serra's tomb.

entities.name: Cathedral of Serra
entities.description: Cathedral on the Plains of Sursi around Serra's tomb.

entities.name: Church of Angelfire
entities.description: Rival religion that opposed the Serrans.

entities.name: Sheoltun Empire
entities.description: Forerunner of Benalia, which lost control of eastern Terisiare after the Uprising in Epityr.

entities.name: Order of Dawn
entities.description: Order led by Lyra that protects Benalia.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation where Serranism was banned and later revived.

events.summary: In the Uprising in Epityr a priest of Serra calls forth Serra Angels to free the town, causing the Sheoltun Empire to lose eastern Terisiare.
events.quote: a priest of Serra called forth the Serra Angels to free the town

events.summary: Serranism is banned in Benalia for centuries after its founding.
events.quote: Serranism was banned in that nation for centuries

events.summary: Refugees from Serra's Realm revive the Church in Benalia.
events.quote: the Church of Serra experienced a revival in Benalia

events.summary: Brother Angus builds the Cathedral of Serra around Serra's tomb.
events.quote: Brother Angus built the Cathedral of Serra around Serra's tomb on the Plains of Sursi
